kaede.title: Two Stolen Bottles
kaede.text: Kaede hauls Sam up the ladder to the roof of the Lantern with two bottles of wine she very obviously did not pay for, the glass still cold and sweating from the cellar. The tiles hold the day's warmth, chimney smoke drifts past the stars, and her copper tail thumps the roof behind her. "Back in my party, nobody ever had my back. Then this skinny guy in a hoodie jumps in front of a goblin for me." She bumps his shoulder with hers. "Idiot." She doesn't move away, and the tail curls around his ankle.

choices.label: Stay on the roof with her
choices.res: Sam finds the bottle in his hand somehow empty and the stars somehow lower. Kaede's tail never unwinds from his ankle, and neither of them points it out.

choices.label: Pass the conversation back to her wine
choices.res: {N} snorts into the bottle and lets him off the hook. Her tail still sneaks one lazy swish against his leg as they climb down.

image.comp: sitting on a rooftop at night bumping shoulders with him, holding a wine bottle, fox tail swishing
image.setting: tiled rooftop over a fantasy town at night, stars, chimney smoke

kaede.title: Wrong Door
kaede.text: Sam shoulders open the washroom door and finds Kaede mid-towel, steam curling off her sun-kissed skin, the thin scar on her shoulder pink from the heat. Every single hair on her tail stands straight up like a startled bottlebrush. For one long second the only sound is a dripping tap and Sam's brain emptying itself of all vocabulary.

choices.label: Apologize and bolt
choices.res: Kaede laughs about it for ten straight minutes. Through the door. Loudly enough that the whole corridor learns what happened, and at dinner she toasts him with a spoon.

choices.label: Compliment her
choices.res: She grins, tail slowly settling, and doesn't bother holding the towel very hard. "Smooth, boss. Real smooth." The warmth in her voice outlasts the steam.

else.res: "GET OUT." The towel hits him square in the face, still warm and smelling of her soap, and the door slams hard enough to rattle the hinges.

choices.label: Stand there like an idiot
choices.res: "Take a picture, it lasts longer." Sam has no idea how she knows that phrase, but she is smirking when she says it, tail fluffed with pride rather than panic.

image.comp: frozen mid-towel in a washroom doorway, every hair on her fox tail standing straight up, wide-eyed

kaede.title: Tail Says Otherwise
kaede.text: Kaede turns up at Sam's door with a bandaged hand and a bright grin, claiming she got hurt sparring "for fun." The knuckles under the linen are split and puffy, and she smells of liniment and sawdust. She sits on the edge of his bed while he unwinds and re-wraps it with clumsy care, and her tail keeps brushing his arm, back and forth, warm and soft. Neither of them mentions it.

choices.label: Finish the bandage slowly
choices.res: He takes his time over the knot, and she lets him, eyes on his hands instead of the wall. Her tail stops pretending it's accidental.

choices.label: Tie it off and tease her about sparring
choices.res: "For fun," Sam repeats, deadpan. {N} flicks his ear for it, but her laugh is soft and she stays seated a minute longer than she needs to.

image.comp: sitting on a kitchen table while he bandages her hand, grinning, fox tail brushing his arm
image.setting: inn kitchen at night, a first-aid kit

kaede.title: The Old Party
kaede.text: Kaede's old party leader turns up at the bar in dungeon-stained leathers, trailing the smell of rain and old smoke. He has a new contract, a deep dungeon and a spot for her, if she wants it. The common room goes quiet. Kaede doesn't look at him; she looks at Sam, ears pinned flat, and waits with her fingers drumming on the counter.

choices.label: "Go, if it's what you want."
choices.res: She stays. Later she grumbles into her cup: "You weren't supposed to make it easy." But she sits close all night.

choices.label: "Stay. Please."
choices.res: Kaede turns the leader down without even looking at him, and the ex-captain leaves with his ears burning. Her tail slaps Sam's leg twice under the bar, hard, happy.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.res: She leaves for two days without a word. When she comes back, she doesn't mention it. Neither does he. It sits between them for a while, like a bill nobody wants to read.

image.comp: standing at a bar between him and a rugged adventurer in armor, arms crossed, looking at him and waiting
image.setting: busy tavern bar, adventurers at tables

kaede.title: Rooftops
kaede.text: Kaede teaches Sam to run the rooftops of Hollowmere at night, hopping slate to slate in the moonlight as though gravity were a polite suggestion. Sam, in his grey hoodie and traveler's cloak, is very, very bad at it. He windmills across a gap, clings to a chimney, and apologizes to a pigeon. Kaede crouches on the ridgeline above, hands on her knees, wheezing with laughter.

choices.label: Keep trying
choices.res: By the end of the night he makes one jump cleanly. She cheers loud enough to wake the whole street, and a shutter bangs open below them. Neither cares.

choices.label: Fake a sprained ankle so she carries you
choices.res: She sees right through it, ears twitching with delight. She carries him anyway, the whole way home, over her shoulder and grumbling that he weighs nothing.

image.comp: leaping across rooftops at night, laughing back at the man clinging to a chimney
image.setting: moonlit rooftops of a fantasy town

kaede.title: Copper Fox, Kept
kaede.text: After closing, Kaede corners Sam in the kitchen, where the stove is still ticking as it cools and one lamp burns low. She drums her fingers on the table, stops, starts again. "I'm bad at this, so I'll just say it. I'm not going anywhere. Not for the money. For you." Her ears are bright red to the tips and her tail won't stop wagging. She takes his hand and leads him upstairs, and the door closes behind them.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.res: {N} nods too fast. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." Her tail droops, then perks up again, stubborn.
